mechanism.name: Measured composition -> physical liquid-fueled cell -> socket -> Gaslight penetration event -> powered weapon state and independently charge-gated light
mechanism.prerequisite: Actual positive compatible liquid volume, supported collector/slot, access/ownership/physical gates and operational powered parts.
mechanism.player_choice: Drain existing content or mix a measured dose; place a physical compatible cell; perform the actual charged item action or preserve remaining fuel.
mechanism.cost: Source material leaves its collector on split; empty-slot insertion pays actor energy1000 by default before possible later refusal. Gaslight configured draw100 is an event cost in a selected hit path, not every attack. Selected pour/fill turn cost unknown.
mechanism.mutation: Weighted component proportions and quantity; socket item/back-reference; retained ChargeCounter; whole-dram depletion; actual weapon fields and local zone light.
mechanism.useful_consumer: Charged/uncharged melee profile plus LightSource actual radius4 zone light gated by charge1. Other generic ActiveLightSource can consume by local tick but positive draw must be configured.
mechanism.failure_aftermath: Dilution rejects usable charge without removing material; inventory removal can fail after energy cost; unavailable requests can partially drain; powered profile and light can have different readiness; final depleted cell notifies, closed vessel remains empty, open puddle can be destroyed.
mechanism.time: Gaslight TurnTick refreshes status, selected combat penetration event consumes. Concrete passive light does not consume on radiation. Separate active-light local tick excludes world map. No YAIR minute equivalence assumed.
mechanism.persistence: Explicit LiquidVolume Write/Read covers quantity/composition. Same-instance partial counter and SameAs demonstrated. Generic counter/socket serialization, derived-state restore and full save/failure remain unread.

evidence.claim: Physical amount, weighted thousandth composition, exact mixture recipe exception, selected transfer/custody/frozen gates, callbacks, component persistence, scalar depletion and open-puddle versus closed-vessel emptying. No universal atomic fill or turn-cost guarantee.

Positive matching composition supplies volume*ChargePerDram-ChargeCounter. Pure single-fuel gate rejects dilution; partial draws retain counter and consume whole drams at threshold. Pass-two insufficient request may spend available charge; depletion notification and no positive electrical recharge.

Physical cell forwarding/back-reference, removal/replacement/slot compatibility and inventory gates. Empty insertion energy is paid before possible inventory-removal refusal. Selected AI selection and holder/custody handling, not full socket serialization.

Penetration event attempts charge use without checking its boolean, then recomputes actual weapon damage/skill/penetration powered state. Turn tick refreshes state without a per-turn draw in this part.

Separate active-light consumer calls operational consumption outside world map and adds actual zone light while ready. Constructor does not specify positive ChargeUse; do not apply continuous drain to all lights.

Concrete passive light checks charge1 and broken/rusted before actual local radiation; no use-charge call in that radiation path. Small positive charge can light while larger weapon-readiness draw fails.
Selected disabled/readiness/charge/minimum/liquid/world-map gates and bulk-failure repeated-use branch; not complete powered-part framework or all providers.
Powered-part defaults; individual declaration/constructor configuration determines cost.
Object wrappers route pooled query/test/use charge events and equipped actor charge event. Not full object serialization or all event handlers.
Registered event plus two-pass handlers; completion convention and charge-used notification do not establish rollback of failed partial requests.
Depleted event notifies cell and slotted holder; no automatic refill/destruction or whole-save proof.
Weapon-targeted event entry point used by real combat and selected conditional score caller.
Legacy and typed dispatch target actual weapon and can invoke its mutating part; no preview-only flag is established here.
Actual penetration event follows hit branch and armor-value support. Not every swing/miss, full combat resolution or last-fuel damage proof.

Conditional adaptive-penetration score path dispatches same event. Activation condition, all callers and whether ordinary Gaslight can reach it remain unread; do not claim universal AI score fuel loss.
Base callback defaults allow mixing and add no post-mix behavior, while specialized overrides remain separate dependencies.
Oil identity and selected physical-property declarations. Whole fire/slip/contact consumers unreviewed.
Selected pure/mixed conductivity and actual weighted hydration/amphibious smear hook; drink dispatcher/time/consumption path not completely traced.
Exposure-weighted immediate and ongoing damage hooks demonstrate a deeper physical-coating consumer. Coating creation/depletion/scheduler/protection remain unread; not a second full path.

original_proposal.name: Metered inspection fuel and one physical cavity retrieval
original_proposal.player_loop: Transfer a measured dose to one owned lamp reservoir; preserve pure fuel or deliberately mix contaminants; complete a paid lamp-guided inspection of a permitted dark cavity; learn only its real fitting position; separately extract the one actual fitting and use the existing fitting/resin/stave kit route.
original_proposal.distinct_consumer: Lamp readiness gates real observation, then conserved once-only physical extraction. New cavity stock is separate from Eda existing pin stock. A slower consented dismantling route reaches the same physical fitting without fuel.
original_proposal.original_values: Names, stock, amounts, durations and thresholds require an original reversible authoring decision; no Qud actor-energy/tick/constants port or new packet is selected.
missing_joins: Native per-carrier quantity/composition and partial-use persistence with stacking/custody validation.
Scoped lamp-readiness/paid-inspection consumer; no existing spatial-light engine is assumed.
Once-only extraction stock and actor-known observation feeding existing fitting/resin/stave kit work.
original_proposal.owner_fit: Use actual native inventory/body/job/site/knowledge owners, registered stale-command gate, common integer played-minute boundary scheduler and durable publisher. Authoritative composition checks legality; motives/reports use only actor-known evidence or attributed testimony. simulationFacts is broader truth, not a universally safe observer projection.
original_proposal.time_policy: Explicit command-completion dose events. Passive light views/rendering/previews/AI score consume nothing. Ongoing minute burn would need a separate explicit event-boundary approximation and interruption order; no tick-to-minute equivalence.
original_proposal.effort: Medium: native carrier reconstruction/validation/save join, conservation/reservations, visible consumer and save compatibility. No measured time estimate.
original_proposal.maintenance: Keep finite components/capacity and one consumer instead of porting Qud event/component runtime. Avoid reusing current single-charge item IDs for a changed meaning.
original_proposal.compatibility: Old absent-carrier saves inert; old full/empty vials and frozen jobs retain meaning. New field/ID admission, conservation/stacking/cancellation policy and later save/reload/failure gate required. Exact serializer/key encoding unreviewed; not migration-ready.
original_proposal.license: Supplied decompilation is evidence, not an open-source dependency/license grant. Adapt original mechanism/code/content; do not distribute proprietary code/prose/assets.
later_observe_gate: Metered transfer conserves real stock and custody; rendering/canceling cannot grant fuel.
Contamination retains volume/material but refuses powered inspection; draining/replacing fuel has disclosed cost and no auto purification.
Two inspections spend distinct portions of same carrier; composition/remaining fuel survive later save/reload without refresh or duplicate inventory.
Only inspector learns actual fitting position; extraction spends real effort and removes one cavity stock once; fitting feeds existing kit route and manual dismantling is actual alternative.
Lost permission/body/site/realm support, stale proposal and publication failure follow explicit cancellation/refund/knowledge policy; no silent duplicated or forgiven partial spend.
original_proposal.gates_status: All gameplay/save/browser/failure/director gates unrun; proposal remains research only.
